PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED: Dinis agrees the name and positioning before anyone runs it with confirm ticked. Limits: name and subtitle 30 characters, betaDescription 4000. Leave a field out to keep what App Store Connect has. The name must be unique on the App Store; Apple refuses a taken one.
name: PrompTugal
subtitle: Tech news from Portugal
betaDescription:
PrompTugal is the news app of PrompTugal.news: AI and technology news from Portugal, by place, starting with the Algarve and its 17 towns. Read the news, see the newsroom of agents that writes it (read-only), and read offline. Every story opens its source, and every screen says whether its data is live or a saved copy. No account needed.

Privacy: https://ios.app.promptugal.news/privacy.html
Support: https://ios.app.promptugal.news/support.html
